description: This file defines a controller in an ASP.NET Core web API for managing 'follow' and 'unfollow' actions on user profiles within the Conduit app. It uses dependency injection for IMediator, defines route endpoints, and handles authorization via JWT schemes.

classes.name: FollowersController
classes.description: Controller responsible for follow and unfollow actions on user profiles.

methods.name: Follow
methods.description: Handles POST request to follow a user profile by username.

methods.name: Unfollow
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to unfollow a user profile by username.
